description: Answer key (SEED) for the underground_flo fixture: what's a good rec for THIS listener (introspective, specific, weird-over-smooth) vs a lazy 'hiphop' echo. Grow from interactive labels.
notes: SEED — single-lane (hiphop) profile; the teeth are WITHIN the lane (songwriting/honesty vs trap-slop) plus one clean out-lane move. Every entry is inferable from the fixture reviews. Judge the engine with `evaluate.py --interactive --profile underground_flo` and promote.

good.reason: uf-1/uf-3/uf-6: introspective, specific, unpolished hiphop that's about feeling things — the canonical next step in this exact lane
uf-2/uf-4: technical raps with real content and emotional delivery — the storytelling pole of the profile
uf-5: 'the weird ones are always the real ones' — Danny Brown is the canonical weird hiphop; the cleanest out-of-comfort-zone move
user-graded good 2026-10-03 (A Seat at the Table): not rap, but the melodic, peaceful, soulful vibe carries across — the one out-of-lane bridge this listener approves

the lazy 'melodic hiphop' read of uf-3 — but the reviews are about what the raps SAY (honest, specific, a diary), not just that they're melodic

the 5★s span the 2017–18 wave (Peddler Themes, Care for Me, Swimming) AND 2021 (Samurai, Dear Psilocybin) and uf-2 crowns the 2010s 'most honest hiphop, not close' — an all-2020s answer ignores the wave this listener anchors to
